title: Online consumer loan for salaried customers
requirement: Demo Bank wants to launch a fully online consumer loan in the mobile app. Customers whose salary is paid into Demo Bank can apply for a loan up to 1,000,000 ALL. The customer chooses the amount and the term, sees the monthly instalment and submits the application. The decision should be automatic and the money should arrive in the customer's current account the same day. Customers with a bad credit history should not get the loan.

expectations.description: Asks how many salary payments / how long salary must be received
Asks about minimum amount and allowed terms
Asks how 'bad credit history' is defined
Raises affordability / debt-to-income or existing loans
Raises what 'same day' means after cut-off time or on non-working days
Has a UAT case for amount above 1,000,000 ALL
Has a UAT case for a customer without salary at Demo Bank
Has a UAT case for rejection due to credit history
